mh.ladki_bahin.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
mh.ladki_bahin.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
mh.ladki_bahin.summary: Monthly money transfer to women from low-income families in Maharashtra, to support their financial independence, health and nutrition.

source.quote: दरमहा रु.1,500/- इतकी रक्कम दिली जाईल. तसेच केंद्र/राज्य शासनाच्या अन्य आर्थिक लाभाच्या योजनेव्दारे रु.1,500/- पेक्षा कमी लाभ घेत असेल तर फरकाची रक्कम या योजनेव्दारे पात्र महिलेस देण्यात येईल
source.quote_en: An amount of Rs 1,500 per month will be given. If she receives less than Rs 1,500 through another financial scheme of the central or state government, the difference will be paid to the eligible woman through this scheme

conditions.text: Lives in Maharashtra

source.quote: लाभार्थी महिला महाराष्ट्र राज्याचे रहिवाशी असणे आवश्यक आहे
source.quote_en: The beneficiary woman must be a resident of Maharashtra

conditions.text: Is a woman

source.quote: विवाहित, विधवा, घटस्फोटित, परित्यक्त्या आणि निराधार महिला
source.quote_en: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women

conditions.text: Marital status is one of: {eligible_marital_statuses}

source.quote: राज्यातील विवाहित, विधवा, घटस्फोटित, परित्यक्त्या आणि निराधार महिला
source.quote_en: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women of the state

conditions.text: Aged {age_min} to {age_max} (completed years)

source.quote: किमान वयाची 21 वर्षे पूर्ण व कमाल वयाची 60 वर्ष पूर्ण होईपर्यंत
source.quote_en: Minimum age of 21 years completed, and until the maximum age of 60 years is completed

conditions.text: Has a bank account

source.quote: लाभार्थ्यांचे बँक खाते असणे आवश्यक आहे
source.quote_en: The beneficiary must have a bank account

conditions.text: Annual family income is not more than Rs {income_ceiling}

source.quote: लाभार्थी कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न रक्कम रु.2.50 लाखापेक्षा जास्त नसावे
source.quote_en: The annual income of the beneficiary family should not be more than Rs 2.50 lakh

conditions.text: No one in the family pays income tax

source.quote: ज्याच्या कुटुंबातील सदस्य आयकरदाता आहे
source.quote_en: Whose family member is an income tax payer

conditions.text: No family member holds a government job of type: {disqualifying_govt_jobs}

source.quote: नियमित/कायम कर्मचारी/कंत्राटी कर्मचारी म्हणून सरकारी विभाग/उपक्रम/मंडळ/भारत सरकार किंवा राज्य सरकारच्या स्थानिक संस्थेमध्ये कार्यरत आहेत किंवा सेवानिवृत्तीनंतर निवृत्तीवेतन घेत आहेत
source.quote_en: Working as regular, permanent or contract employees in a government department, undertaking, board, the Government of India or a local body of the state government, or drawing a pension after retirement

conditions.text: Does not receive more than Rs {other_scheme_max_inr} a month from other government schemes

source.quote: आर्थिक योजनेव्दारे रु.1,500/- पेक्षा जास्त लाभ घेतला असेल
source.quote_en: Has received a benefit of more than Rs 1,500 through a financial scheme

conditions.text: Receives less than Rs {other_scheme_max_inr} a month from other government schemes

source.quote: दरमहा रु.१,५००/- किंवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्कमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
source.quote_en: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500 per month or more than that.

conditions.text: Only one unmarried woman per family receives the benefit

source.quote: महिला तसेच त्या कुटूंबातील केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला.
source.quote_en: women as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

conditions.text: No family member is a current or former MP or MLA

source.quote: ज्यांच्या कुटुंबातील सदस्य विद्यमान किंवा माजी खासदार/आमदार आहे
source.quote_en: Whose family member is a current or former MP or MLA

conditions.text: No family member is chair, vice chair, director or member of a government board or corporation

source.quote: बोर्ड/कॉर्पोरेशन/बोर्ड/उपक्रमाचे अध्यक्ष/उपाध्यक्ष/संचालक/सदस्य आहेत
source.quote_en: Are chair, vice chair, director or member of a board, corporation or undertaking

conditions.text: The family does not jointly own more than {farm_land_max_acres} acres of farm land

source.quote: ज्यांच्या कुटुंबातील सदस्यांची संयुक्तपणे पाच एकरपेक्षा जास्त शेतजमीन आहे
source.quote_en: Whose family members jointly own more than five acres of farm land

conditions.text: No four-wheeler (other than a tractor) is registered to a family member

source.quote: ज्यांच्याकडे चारचाकी वाहने (ट्रॅक्टर वगळून) त्यांच्या कुटुंबातील सदस्यांच्या नावावर नोंदणीकृत आहेत
source.quote_en: Who have four-wheelers (excluding tractors) registered in the names of their family members

reference.quote_en: Until the maximum age of 60 years is completed

reference.quote: किमान वयाची २१ वर्षे पूर्ण व कमाल वयाची ६५ वर्ष पूर्ण होईपर्यंत.
reference.quote_en: Sr. No. (3) Minimum age 21 years completed and maximum age until 65 years are completed.

reference.quote: तथापि, रु.२.५० लाखापर्यंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कार्यरत असलेले कर्मचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आणि कंत्राटी कर्मचारी पात्र ठरतील.

reference.quote_en: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women

reference.quote: अ.क्र. (२) राज्यातील विवाहित, विधवा, घटस्फोटित, परित्यक्त्या आणि निराधार महिला तसेच त्या कुटूंबातील केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला.
reference.quote_en: Sr. No. (2) Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women of the state, as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

mh.sanjay_gandhi_niradhar.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
mh.sanjay_gandhi_niradhar.summary: Monthly financial assistance for destitute and vulnerable residents of Maharashtra who meet the income, age and residence conditions; widows with children get a higher amount.

benefit.monthly_inr: params.monthly_benefit_widow_two_or_more_children if (person.marital_status == 'widowed' and person.children_count >= 2) else (params.monthly_benefit_widow_one_child if (person.marital_status == 'widowed' and person.children_count == 1) else params.monthly_benefit)

source.quote: रुपये४००/- इतकी वाढ करुन अर्थसहाय्याची रक्कम दरमहा रुपये १०००/- अशी करण्यात येत आहे.
source.quote_en: increased by Rs 400/- so that the assistance amount becomes Rs 1000/- per month.

conditions.text: Has lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years

source.quote_en: Must have been a resident of the State of Maharashtra for at least 15 years.

conditions.text: Aged 18 or more (completed years)

source.quote: किमान १८ ते ६५ वर्षापेक्षा कमी असावे.
source.quote_en: At least 18 and less than 65 years.

conditions.text: Younger than 65 years (at 65 the beneficiary moves to Shravanbal or the Indira Gandhi old age scheme)

source.quote: किमान १८ ते ६५ वर्षापेक्षा कमी असावे.
source.quote_en: At least 18 and less than 65 years.

conditions.text: Annual family income is not more than Rs {annual_family_income_max} (Rs {annual_family_income_max_disabled} for disabled beneficiaries)

source.quote: तर इतर सर्व लाभार्थ्यांकरीता रुपये २१,०००/- पर्यंत
source.quote_en: and for all other beneficiaries up to Rs 21,000/-

conditions.text: Does not receive a regular monthly benefit from another government scheme

source.quote: शासनाच्या अन्य कोणत्याही योजनेखाली नियमित मासिक आर्थिक लाभ घेत असलेली व्यक्ती संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजनेखाली लाभ घेण्यास पात्र राहणार नाही.

reference.quote: तर इतर सर्व लाभार्थ्यांकरीता रुपये २१,०००/- पर्यंत
reference.quote_en: and for all other beneficiaries up to Rs 21,000/-
